testcase.system-out: Scenario: Home and End leave the focused panel row unchanged ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full top-docked 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ And the direct panel selector is open with Create focused and checked ✔ When the user presses Home ✔ Then Create remains focused and checked ✔ And the panel selector remains open ✔ When the user presses End ✔ Then Create remains focused and checked ✔ And the panel selector remains open ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the panel selector closes
